rules.label: kb-rules-2026-10-19
rules.text:
# KB extractor — deterministic rules. The engine loads, validates and hashes this file.
# Every check in the output cites rule_id + rules_version (sha256 of this file).
# Allowed severities for checks: passed | discrepancy | warning | manual_review
# (FIELD_RECONCILE may also map to "missing" because it is a field status).
schema_version: 1
label: "kb-rules-2026-10-19"

rules:
  - id: FIELD_RECONCILE
    scope: field
    description:
      es: "Concilia Textract y Bedrock campo a campo. El código decide; el LLM nunca elige el valor."
      en: "Reconciles Textract and Bedrock per field. Code decides; the LLM never picks the value."
    params:
      pass_conf: 0.9                 # Textract conf needed for 'passed' when both engines agree
      amount_ocr_wins_min_conf: 0.9  # on amount disagreement, OCR value is kept only at >= this conf; else Bedrock
      ocr_preferred_min_conf: 0.4    # other OCR-native types: keep OCR value on disagreement from this conf
      ocr_preferred_types: [amount, date, birth_number, iban, id, name]
      text_similarity: 0.92          # address/free text agreement ratio
      amount_tolerance: 0.01         # relative tolerance for amounts to count as agreement
    severity:
      agree_high_conf: passed
      agree_low_conf: warning
      llm_only: warning
      ocr_only_high_conf: warning
      ocr_only_low_conf: manual_review
      disagree: manual_review
      both_missing: missing

  - id: RC_VALID
    scope: document
    check: birth_number_valid
    description:
      es: "Rodné číslo válido: 10 dígitos divisibles por 11 (o regla legacy), o 9 dígitos antes de 1954; mes con offsets."
      en: "Valid Czech birth number: 10 digits divisible by 11 (or legacy rule), or 9 digits before 1954; month offsets."
    params:
      modulus: 11
      lengths: [9, 10]
      nine_digit_before_year: 1954
      century_pivot_yy: 54           # 10-digit: yy >= pivot -> 19yy, else 20yy
      female_month_offsets: [50, 70]
      male_month_offsets: [20]       # +20 / +70 exist since 2004 when numbers ran out
      allow_legacy_check_digit_zero: true   # first 9 digits mod 11 == 10 and last digit 0
    severity:
      valid: passed
      invalid: discrepancy

  - id: RC_BIRTHDATE_MATCH
    scope: document
    check: birth_date_matches_birth_number
    description:
      es: "La fecha de nacimiento del documento coincide con la codificada en el rodné číslo."
      en: "Document birth date matches the date encoded in the birth number."
    params: {}
    severity:
      match: passed
      mismatch: discrepancy

  - id: CONTRACT_INCOME_NOT_LOAN
    scope: document
    check: declared_income_not_loan_amount
    description:
      es: "El ingreso declarado no puede ser igual al importe del préstamo (señal de extracción errónea)."
      en: "Declared income must not equal the loan amount (sign of mis-extraction)."
    params: {}
    severity:
      ok: passed
      equal: discrepancy

  - id: ID_NOT_EXPIRED
    scope: document
    check: id_card_not_expired
    description:
      es: "El documento de identidad no está caducado en la fecha del contrato."
      en: "The ID card is not expired at the contract date."
    params: {}
    severity:
      valid: passed
      expired: discrepancy

  - id: XDOC_BIRTH_NUMBER
    scope: package
    check: birth_number_consistent
    description:
      es: "El rodné číslo es el mismo en todos los documentos que lo llevan."
      en: "Birth number is identical across all documents carrying it."
    params: {}
    severity:
      consistent: passed
      inconsistent: discrepancy

  - id: XDOC_FIRST_NAME
    scope: package
    check: first_name_consistent
    description:
      es: "El nombre coincide entre documentos (sin diacríticos ni mayúsculas)."
      en: "First name matches across documents (diacritics/case-insensitive)."
    params: {}
    severity:
      consistent: passed
      inconsistent: discrepancy

  - id: XDOC_LAST_NAME
    scope: package
    check: last_name_consistent
    description:
      es: "El apellido coincide entre documentos; casi-iguales (typo) son aviso."
      en: "Surname matches across documents; near-misses (typos) are a warning."
    params:
      near_miss_ratio: 0.85
    severity:
      consistent: passed
      near_miss: warning
      engine_disagreement: warning
      inconsistent: discrepancy

  - id: XDOC_FULL_NAME
    scope: package
    check: holder_name_consistent
    description:
      es: "El titular (extracto / justificante de domicilio) coincide con nombre+apellido del contrato."
      en: "Holder name (statement / proof of address) matches the contract first+last name."
    params:
      near_miss_ratio: 0.85
    severity:
      consistent: passed
      near_miss: warning
      inconsistent: discrepancy

  - id: XDOC_ADDRESS
    scope: package
    check: address_consistent
    description:
      es: "La dirección coincide entre contrato, DNI y justificante (similitud de texto)."
      en: "Address matches across contract, ID and proof of address (text similarity)."
    params:
      similarity: 0.85
    severity:
      consistent: passed
      inconsistent: warning

  - id: XDOC_INCOME
    scope: package
    description:
      es: "Ingreso declarado en contrato vs nómina vs abono de salario en extracto, con tolerancia relativa."
      en: "Contract declared income vs payslip net vs salary credit on statement, relative tolerance."
    params:
      tolerance: 0.01
      pairs:
        - {check: income_contract_vs_payslip, a: contract.declared_monthly_income, b: payslip.net_income}
        - {check: income_contract_vs_statement, a: contract.declared_monthly_income, b: bank_statement.salary_credit}
        - {check: income_payslip_vs_statement, a: payslip.net_income, b: bank_statement.salary_credit}
    severity:
      within_tolerance: passed
      out_of_tolerance: discrepancy

  - id: LOAN_AMOUNT_PRESENT
    scope: package
    check: loan_amount_present
    description:
      es: "El contrato tiene importe de préstamo."
      en: "The contract carries a loan amount."
    params: {}
    severity:
      present: passed
      absent: manual_review

  - id: COMPLETENESS
    scope: package
    check: required_documents_present
    description:
      es: "Están todos los documentos que exige el contrato (o la lista por defecto si el contrato no la trae)."
      en: "All documents required by the contract are present (or the default list if the contract has none)."
    params:
      default_required: [id_card, bank_statement, payslip, proof_of_address]
    severity:
      complete: passed
      incomplete: manual_review

  - id: PAGE_CONTINUITY
    scope: package
    check: pages_complete
    description:
      es: "Cada documento multipágina tiene todas sus páginas (según marcas 'Página x de y')."
      en: "Each multi-page document has all its pages (per 'Page x of y' markers)."
    params: {}
    severity:
      complete: passed
      gap: manual_review
      no_markers: passed

  - id: UNEXPECTED_DOCUMENTS
    scope: package
    check: no_unrequested_documents
    description:
      es: "Documentos aportados que el contrato no pide (se avisa, no se bloquea)."
      en: "Documents provided that the contract does not require (warn, do not block)."
    params:
      ignore_types: [contract]
    severity:
      none: passed
      present: warning

next_step:
  description:
    es: "Política de siguiente paso. Se evalúa en orden; gana la primera condición que se cumple."
    en: "Next-step policy. Evaluated in order; first matching condition wins."
  params:
    manual_review_extraction_min_fields: 3
  order:
    - {when: any_check_discrepancy, step: manual_review_discrepancy}
    - {when: missing_documents_or_pages, step: request_missing_documents}
    - {when: many_field_manual_review, step: manual_review_extraction}
    - {when: any_warning_or_manual_review, step: spot_check_warnings}
    - {when: always, step: approve_ready}
